content: He who conceals his sickness from the healer cannot expect the medicine to work.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Pride is the deadliest barrier to healing. When we hide our addictions, our financial panic, our depression, or our moral failures behind a brave face, we guarantee the poison spreads deeper into the bone. Healing begins the moment you speak the honest truth.
practicalInsight: Confide an honest struggle in a trusted friend or mentor today. Allow the light of honest exposure to begin the healing.
reflectionPrompt: What sickness—emotional, financial, or spiritual—are you hiding behind a mask of false competence?
